tasks.short: Direct acquisition of land for the project.

steps.what: List parcel constraints for the construction project.
Direct acquisition of the land with the owner.
Record the instruction to the land agent.

tasks.design: Known parcel constraints are listed from {DOCS}: access, title notes, and planning limits already on file. The construction manager directs the acquisition in discussion with the owner. An instruction to the land agent is recorded only after that discussion. The list does not make an offer. A parcel with no title note is not treated as clear.
tasks.previous_blocker: The owner meeting started without the title notes, and a constraint appeared after the price was discussed.
tasks.enabler_now: Notes already on file can be listed. Buying or optioning the land is still a directed negotiation.
tasks.still_hard: An owner who will not sell, a title defect, and a price the project cannot carry.
tasks.human_edge: The manager hears what the owner needs, and knows when to stop rather than push a number the file suggested.
tasks.altitude: The constraints are in the room. Directing the acquisition stays with the manager. The file makes no offer.

reach.task: Negotiate land and access in person, with the constraints written down first.
reach.learn: A constraint list is not an offer. This manager still directs the acquisition.

evidence.claim: A file can list constraints already recorded on a parcel. It cannot negotiate with the owner.
An offer for land is a legal and commercial act. The manager directs it. The job digest keeps negotiation manual. Nothing here signs a transfer.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: A construction manager at a European contractor or client team. National building rules apply. A register does not replace a site visit.

Fields: Parcel id and constraint notes, produced by the project land file. Absence of a title note is shown as unknown, not as clear title. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the manager finishes it by hand.
Native check: Read the existing land file before a new map tool.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the manager.
unknowns: Whether a land agent or the manager speaks to the owner.
research_questions: Are title and access notes already in the project file?
Which acquisitions failed on a constraint found late?

already_counted.description: The manager still directs the acquisition talks.
The manager still records the instruction.

incremental.description: The manager adds a constraint when a new title note arrives.

approvals.approved_version: parcel id and the instruction text shown to the manager

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The acquisition talk is the task. Saving is the constraint list, and it shrinks when the land file is empty and the manager still gathers the notes by hand.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The manager still directs the acquisition of land. A parcel list can be assembled. The conversation with the owner does not move.
reach: Wind energy development managers negotiate land and access, and this job learns the same limit: the talk stays a person.
skills_to_grow: Separate a parcel fact from an offer.
Record an instruction to the land agent without letting the file make the offer.
role.ambitious_version: The parcel constraints are on one page before the owner meeting, and the manager still directs the acquisition.
